svg.aria-label: Constructed fluorescence data, seed 640. L contains 100, 70, 40, 25 and 15 kDa markers; standard loads are 0, 20, 40 and 80 ng. U contains 55 ng major and 12 ng minor components. Dashed lines mark origin and reference front. Position and intensity are calibrated separately.
